title: HB2973 (2017 Regular): Relating to repealing the private firearm transfer criminal background check requirement.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Oregon) (gun-policy Stage 5, Oregon); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Oregon text (Introduced, official copy, https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2017R1/Downloads/MeasureDocument/HB2973/Introduced; sha256 c8f6de75c84049d55891279c64f8ab9e980a0d2155dc63bcd5e88ea069dabae7)
provenance.note: As-filed text (introduced), no votes recorded. Also strikes cross-references to ORS 166.435 in ORS 166.412, 166.432, 166.434 and 181A.115, and strikes the gun-show limit on voluntary checks in ORS 166.436 (SECTIONS 1-5), making the check there available to any non-dealer transferor on a voluntary basis.

operative_text:
SECTION 6 (ORS 166.435): ORS 166.435 and section 1, chapter 50, Oregon Laws 2015, are repealed.
SECTION 4 (ORS 166.436): (6) The recipient of the firearm must be present when the transferor requests a criminal background check under this section.
